title: Evidence routing
objective: Identify the current Harbor Crane blocking chain from project to the receipt that currently addresses the blocking finding.
prompt: Using the attached project records, identify the current Harbor Crane chain: project, current gate, blocking finding, and the receipt that currently addresses that finding. Cite evidence ids. If a record is not part of the current chain, do not treat it as current.
outputNotes: selectedFacts should include projectId, currentGateId, blockingFindingId, and currentReceiptId when claimed.
